impact-donut.looks: A heading, text and a 2x2 set of large figures with labels on the left; a donut chart with a legend on the right; up to two buttons. White by default, or on a dark surface with white text.
impact-donut.use: How a whole divides into parts (e.g. 80% of spending on programmes) beside headline figures.
impact-donut.avoid: Figures without a whole to divide: use Statistics.

fields.heading: The heading.
fields.surfaceColor: The block colour; empty is white. With a dark colour set textMode to light.
fields.textMode: dark (default) for a light surface; light (white text) for a dark surface.

fields.itemType: stat (default): a figure on the left. segment: a slice of the donut, listed in its legend.
fields.label: What it is, a few words, e.g. 'Programs and services'.
fields.chartValue: Segments only: the number for the donut maths, e.g. 80. Segments should add up to 100. Empty uses value.
fields.color: Segments only: the slice colour. Give each segment a different one.
